task_summary: Rebuild the psoriasis pathway/enrichment layer on a statistically consistent footing

steps.title: Build meta-ranked GSEA
steps.description: Rank genes by the random-effects meta statistic (pooled z from meta_de_PPvsNN.csv) for k=4, and repeat for the k=7 cohort (meta_de_PPvsNN_7study.csv). Run fgsea on Hallmark, Reactome, GO:BP, KEGG with eps=0, fixed seed. Contrast against the existing mega-analysis GSEA to quantify how much significance was inflated.

steps.title: Rebuild competitive-meta pathway test
steps.description: Re-run per-study CAMERA on the FULL study set (k=4, and k=7 where available), then combine without the 1e-308 floor / Z=38 cap. Use precision-weighted Stouffer or a rank-based combination; report a combined statistic that is not saturated. Replace meta_pathway_camera_PPvsNN.csv.

steps.title: Joint testing + redundancy collapse
steps.description: Apply multiple-testing across the combined collection set and collapse redundant gene sets (leading-edge overlap clustering / GO-hierarchy prune) into a non-redundant top-pathway table.

steps.title: Figure + methods note
steps.description: Produce a consolidated pathway figure and a short methods note documenting the corrected methodology and a before/after comparison table (old mega/broken-CAMERA vs corrected meta-based results), so the change is auditable.

desired_outputs: Corrected GSEA table ranked on random-effects meta statistic (k=4 and k=7)
Valid competitive-meta pathway table replacing the broken CAMERA pooling
Non-redundant top-pathway summary with joint multiple-testing
Pathway methods note + before/after comparison documenting what changed and why

feasibility.rationale: All inputs exist as project artifacts (per-study and meta-analysis DE tables for k=4 and k=7, per-study SEs). The fixes are standard, well-established enrichment methods; no new data or external services required. Main judgment call is the redundancy-collapse threshold, which I'll set transparently.
